scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Welcome
to Einbroch,
the City of Steel.
Please ask me if you
have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
歡迎來到鋼鐵之城——艾音布羅克。
有什麼問題，儘管問我。

scripts.text: City Guide.
scripts.translation: 城市導覽

scripts.text: Remove Marks from Mini-Map.
scripts.translation: 移除小地圖示記

scripts.text: Notice.
scripts.translation: 告示

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
需要我在您的小地圖上標記位置嗎？

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The ^FF0000Airport^000000 is located
in the northwestern part
of the city. There you can
see our city's pride and joy, the Airship. Remember that you must pay admission to board the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
^FF0000機場^000000位於城西北。
在那裡，您能看到這座城引以為傲的飛空艇。
請記住，登上飛空艇需要支付入場費。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Train Station is
located in the northeast
part of Einbroch. Trains
running between here
and Einbech run all day
long, everyday.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
火車站位於艾音布羅克東北部。
往返這裡與艾音貝赫的火車，每天全天執行。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Factory, perhaps the
most important facility in
Einbroch, is located in the
southern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
工廠位於城南，或許是艾音布羅克最重要的設施。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Plaza, our biggest
shopping district, can be
found just east from the
center of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
廣場是本城最大的購物區，就在艾音布羅克中心的東側。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Hotel is east of
the Plaza and offers top
caliber accomodations.
There, you can enjoy your
stay in Einbroch in comfort~
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
酒店位於廣場東邊，提供一流的住宿服務。
您可以在那裡舒舒服服地度過艾音布羅克之旅~

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Weapon Shop is
located north from the
Plaza. There you can
purchase weapons for
your personal use.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
武器店位於廣場北邊，您可以在那裡購買自己使用的武器。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Laboratory is an
annex of the Factory and
is located in the southwest
sector of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
實驗室是工廠的附屬設施，位於艾音布羅克西南部。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Blacksmith Guild is
located in the southeast
part of Einbroch. You can
upgrade your equipment
by using their services.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
鐵匠公會位於艾音布羅克東南部。
您可以利用他們的服務提升裝備。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
The Einbroch Tower is
located in the center of
the city. From the top of
the tower, you can view
all of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
艾音布羅克塔位於城中心。
登上塔頂，就能俯瞰整座城市。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbroch Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
如果不想讓小地圖繼續顯示地點標記，請選擇“移除小地圖示記”。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 否

[Einbroch Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:

如果不想讓小地圖繼續顯示地點標記，請選擇“移除小地圖示記”。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Okay, the marks from
your Mini-Map have been
removed. If you need any
guidance around Einbroch,
please let me or one of the
other Einbroch Guides know.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
好的，小地圖上的標記已經移除了。
在艾音布羅克需要指路的話，隨時可以找我或其他嚮導。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Through the technology of
the Schwarzwald Republic,
we've upgraded to a digital
information system that allows
us to mark locations on your
Mini-Map for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
藉助修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的技術，我們升級了數字資訊系統。
現在可以在您的小地圖上標記地點，讓您更容易找到路。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
小地圖位於螢幕右上角。
如果看不到，請按Ctrl + Tab，或點選基本資訊視窗中的“地圖”按鈕。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in Einbroch, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
點選小地圖上的“+”和“-”，就能放大或縮小地圖。
冒險者，祝您在艾音布羅克旅行愉快。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
We hope that you
enjoy your travels
here in Einbroch.
Oh, and please be
aware of the Smog Alerts.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
祝您在艾音布羅克旅行愉快。
哦，還有，別忘了留意煙霧警報。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
Welcome to Einbech,
the Mining Town. We're
here to assist tourists,
so if you have any questions,
please feel free to ask us.
scripts.translation:
[艾音貝赫嚮導]
歡迎來到礦業小鎮——艾音貝赫。
我們專門為遊客提供幫助，有什麼問題，儘管問。

a location from

scripts.translation:

請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾音貝赫嚮導]

忙碌一天後，去那裡放鬆一下再好不過。

scripts.text:

a location from

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbech Guide]
The Swordman Guild
is located in the eastern
outskirts of Einbech. It's

haven't started accepting
applications.
scripts.translation:

請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾音貝赫嚮導]
劍士公會位於艾音貝赫東郊。
目前還在建設中，尚未開始接受申請。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Einbech Guide]
The Mine, which is
Einbech's major industry,
is located in the northern
part of this town. It's where
we get all our ores, although monsters get in the miners' way.
scripts.translation:

請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾音貝赫嚮導]

我們的礦石全都出自那裡，可魔物總妨礙礦工的工作。
